info.title: OpesCare API
info.description:
OpesCare's full REST API surface — Connect interoperability, SDK, Bridge agent, FHIR R4, clinical, and platform endpoints.

**Auto-generated** from the live route table by `php artisan opescare:generate-openapi` (306 operations across 276 paths). Every path is therefore a real registered route — the spec cannot drift (enforced by OpenApiContractTest). Security is derived from each route's middleware; request/response bodies are generic stubs except for the hand-curated operations in config/openapi.php (full schemas).

ClientId.name: X-Client-ID
ClientId.description: B2B integration client id (send with X-Client-Secret).
